purpose: One-shot receive-dispatch witness with ROM warmstart routes redirected to cold initialization

patches.meaning: halt and display at LinkRxDispatcher entry

display: I ss rr: ss is LINK_STATUS, rr is LINK_RXD if LINK_STATUS bit 0 was set, otherwise 00; hook halts
limitations: The reset-path and direct ROM warmstart jumps are forced to cold initialization. Uncharacterized RAM-resident restart behavior has not been tested on hardware.
A display may result from self-reception or unrelated link IRQ; compare silent and transmitted conditions.
